title: Revenue Share Concentration
description: Report the **revenue share** of each customer: their spend as a fraction of total company revenue, rounded to 2 decimals. Also report a **running cumulative share** sorted from the biggest customer down. Name the columns `customer_id`, `revenue`, `share`, and `cumulative_share`. Order rows by descending revenue, breaking ties by `customer_id`.
solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       revenue,
       ROUND(revenue * 1.0 / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS share,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
            * 1.0 / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_share
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id;
hint: Total revenue is a window aggregate over all customers; the cumulative share is a running SUM sorted by revenue. ORDER BY ties on customer_id.
outputExplanation: Customer 2 drives $500 of the $1000 total (50%); cumulatively the top 2 customers cover 75%.
